delta: Reuse the reviewed parser implementation and fixed options. Remove every mutation argument and test-only alteration.

Replace the path-taking adapter with a buffer-taking adapter. The entry checks one fixed original file and passes the same checked bytes, avoiding a second original read. Original display name is the fixed name original.

Keep profile.mjs byte-identical, including its historical experiment labels and historical output quota. The identified intake-worker/3 contract supplies effective execution/output bounds; original, ZIP, sheet, cell and CSV input limits remain unchanged.
Rename the isolated package, remove the historical run.mjs npm script and pin Node 22.16.0 in engines. All dependency lock entries, archives and upstream notices remain unchanged.
Add the closed stdin worker envelope, bounded command read, exact original identity validation, bounded structured failure codes and full escaped reply measurement. No mutation option is exposed.

Use the direct observation object in intake-worker/3. Preserve actual outer reply bytes rather than nesting JSON text. Enforce the shared 40 MiB full-envelope cap; separate normalization/conservation quotas belong to the receiving service. A bounded output failure does not change admitted input formats or claim universal completion.
verification_scope: Host adapter/package and request/reply checks do not certify Linux fixed-path execution, operating-system containment, full storage/query size, service authority or universal XLSX fidelity.
resource_semantics: Relations and resources are empty for these adapters. Ordinary cell prose is not native Excel comments; an unsupported SVG part is not image interpretation.
